sections.description: Internal Kingdom tool for managing Sermons, Events, and Calendar views (with recurrence).
sections.changelog:
• Fixed Theme 2 sermon cards so sermon thumbnails fully fill the left side even when descriptions are longer.
  • Added a new sermon taxonomy: Churches.
  • Added Church filter support to sermon list widgets and shortcodes.
  • Updated sermon filters to hide empty Speaker, Series, and Church dropdowns when no terms are assigned.
  • Added Churches to import/export support.
  • Fixed missing Churches taxonomy registration.
  • Added Churches taxonomy to the Sermons admin menu and sermon edit screen.
